views.text: In May 2026, Equity Mates described WiseTech’s CargoWise as handling complex global logistics tasks like tariffs and route legality, arguing the complexity made it hard to replicate and attractive for core customers such as DHL and FedEx.

views.text: In November 2025, Equity Mates noted an upgraded wide‑moat view on WiseTech and pointed to strong profitability, citing 84% gross margin, 40% operating margin and 25% net profit margin as evidence of durable advantage.
